title: Refuse path-shaped shared-note authors in final or unlisted slash segments
outcome: Refuse path-shaped shared-note authors in final or unlisted slash segments
acceptance: Shared-note export omission and candidate dry/apply refusal cover greg/.ssh, x/etc/shadow, team/var/lib/engram/key.pem and x/users, with unchanged target state and no body or id in shared bytes
Normal principals such as greg/claude, org.example/codex and Engram::Fable remain admitted

completion.summary:
Task-sync note authors and activity actors are now judged as paths by their whole value as well as per word: three or more slash segments, a dot-leading segment, or a last segment that is a listed prefix (ignoring trailing glue) is refused, so spaces cannot split x/My Documents/key.pem into allowed pieces. Export omits such notes and activity; import refuses them dry and apply before any write. Two-segment principals such as greg/claude, org.example/codex, team/docs-bot and Engram::Fable stay admitted.
